description: ZuluThermo provides hydraulic and thermal calculations for district heating networks. The provider describes network calibration, heat-loss and capacity calculations, outage analysis and graphical model construction through ZuluGIS. The provider is Politerm. Coverage: The software supports branched and looped networks with multiple sources and pumps. Coverage and analysis periods depend on the user’s network. Access: The provider page links documentation and software access. Installers were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The provider offers product and licensing information; an exact price and full reuse terms were not established. Limitations: The reported functions were checked in documentation, not by executing the software. ZuluGIS integration and other required licences need confirmation. For simulation it supports heating-network design, operating-regime comparison and capacity assessment. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
